regions.merged_text: I am just starting, for a day or P. S. Pl. pardon hast. so at Milwaukee, Wis.
regions.full_page: P. S. Pl. pardon hast. £ I am just starting, for a day or so at Milwaukee, Wis.
regions.per_polygon: I am just starting, for a day or P. S. Pl. pardon hast. so at Milwaukee, Wis.

regions.merged_text: Dear Mrs. Doyle: God bless you . . . I am sending this (above) just as I found it this morning. With several others I got From- ane poison in Milwaukee and had an experience quite worthwhile. Thanks be to God. Afterwards too, here and in St. Joseph Hospital in Ft. Wayne. Doctor Hoffman there, I hear, feared I would lose my lower legs. I never thought of such a serious thing. Thank God they are again quite OK.
